text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало has won the autumn Tenno
Sho. She
closes her eyes and embraces
the cheers of the
crowd before turning
away from the applause.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She faces her two fiercest competitors,
Special
Week and Сэйун Скай.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The three exchange their deepest
feelings—their
frustrations, their regrets,
and their
gratitude—and laugh together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A gust of wind blows past them, carrying
their
voices toward the future where
they'll continue to
run as rivals and as
friends.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
